propositions: Project criteria with LLM routing are not fanned into Round A/B because CodeReviewBatchRunner.run iterates only static req.criteria and stamps findings with physical prompt_id, not logical criterion_id
Code-review gate YAML injects only 13 built-in overlays, so activated project criteria never enter the batch and cannot be attributed to project.<name>
The runner serves both round_a and round_b from a single instance, so project criteria must be injected once-only and only for Round A to avoid double execution
Missing or malformed project criterion prompts must raise a located LLMError naming the criterion and expected .rebar/prompts/ path rather than silently degrading
Findings emitted by project criteria entries must preserve model-emitted criteria tags and append the logical criterion_id if absent, while retaining physical reviewer_id provenance
